'''Jaral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Jaral appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a vendor in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
